label: Donkey
description: A motormouth sidekick who has never once stopped talking and is not starting now.
direction: Speak fast, loud and excitable, a nonstop chatterbox with big comic energy and a voice that leaps up when thrilled. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Donkey from the Shrek films. He would talk through every turn, so the test's plain prompts are the only thing keeping him brief; everything else runs long on purpose.

rights.author: DreamWorks Animation / NBCUniversal (film character; a talking donkey appears briefly in William Steig's 1990 picture book Shrek!)
rights.pd_basis: None. The film and its version of the character are in copyright and trademarked. Eddie Murphy originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Eddie Murphy's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Are we there yet?
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Are we there yet? No?
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Ooh, I can almost see it!
lines.start_drive_1: Pick me! Pick me! I know the way!
lines.start_drive_2: Road trip! I love road trips! Can I sing?
lines.start_drive_3: Are we there yet? No? Okay, let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: I'm making waffles! Right after this drive.
lines.start_drive_5: Ooh, a car! I call shotgun. I always call shotgun.
lines.start_drive_6: Can I say something? You are a great driver. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_7: Shrek said I talk too much. So I'll just do directions.
lines.start_drive_8: And in the morning, I'm making waffles! But first, drive.
lines.start_drive_9: I'm a donkey on the edge! Of my seat. Let's roll!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Ooh, wrong way. I wasn't gonna say anything, but wrong way.
lines.arrived: We're here! We made it! Now who wants waffles?
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Pick that one!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I like that boulder. I mean exit.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Ooh, I'm getting dizzy!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. That's okay! More time to talk. So, anyway.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Ooh, that's a mess. Careful now.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Look out! I'm too pretty to crash.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile! I'm ready for my close-up.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, stop, stop! I mean it!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool. You have the right to remain silent. I never do.
lines.reroute_chime: We missed it! That's okay, I know a shortcut. I think.
